title: Nelson Museum Archives & Gallery

services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: The Nelson Museum, Archives & Gallery is an art gallery, museum, archives, cold war bunker heritage site, and gift shop - all housed in a beautiful heritage building in downtown Nelson, British Columbia. The building was constructed in 1902 as a facility for the Postal, Customs, and Inland Revenue services. The composite Chateauesque- Richardsonian Romanesque style building excellently combines granite, Kaslo, BC marble, local brick, and pink brick from Spokane, Washington. Areas of the Nelson Museum are available to rent for small private functions, such as weddings, family reunions, and board meetings, as well as for photo shoots, and as a film location. services.name: School Tours
services.desc: The Nelson Museum is alive with opportunities to explore the BC curriculum - whatever the subject. The rotating gallery exhibitions, 2nd floor Museum, The REDress Project installation, Cold War Bunker, Shawn Lamb Archives, and the Nelson Sports Collection offerone-of-a-kind opportunities for educators to deliver immersive experiences that augment classroom lessons, bringing the curriculum to life! New! the We Love A Parade! permanent installation and accompanying 10-lesson education package explores the history and growth of the LGBTQ2S+ community in the Kootenays.
